nodes.speaker: applejack
nodes.text: Somepony got into the habit of stealing apples from my farm. Have you seen her by any chance?

nodes.speaker: applejack
nodes.text: Well, it couldn't have run away on its own, right?

nodes.speaker: applejack
nodes.text: Okay. If you see her, tell her that of course we have a lot of apples, but it's better to buy it anyway.

nodes.speaker: applejack
nodes.text: I'm already selling it almost for free.
